text:
alex: quick note - onboarding sampleapp failing in prod because SDK can't call the models.metadata endpoint (404) even though REST returns 200. Seeing a mismatch in available endpoints between SDK and API.

ting: can you paste the curl vs sdk call?

alex: sure. REST (works):
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \ 
  https://api.redwood.ai/models/metadata?model=redwood-chat-1
# -> 200 json
```
SDK (404):
```
await client.models.metadata({ model: 'redwood-chat-1' })
# -> throws 404 Not Found
```
No client-side stack trace in SDK that hints at endpoint mismatch.

ravi: hmm - two likely causes: (1) SDK was released before we added models.metadata to the server API surface, (2) path naming drift (metadata vs meta). Also, SDK auth wrapper is silently retrying once on 401 which double-submits some POSTs in onboarding flow.

alex: yes the onboarding flow makes an idempotent-ish POST to /projects/create and the retry turned one failed 401 into a duplicate project. UX nightmare.

ting: we should do three things: (A) sync SDK endpoint catalog with server (add metadata), (B) make retry idempotency-aware for POSTs or disable retry on 401, and (C) improve SDK runtime errors to include helpful hint when 404 could be an API/SDK mismatch.

ravi: small gotcha I noticed while debugging sampleapp: stop_sequences param handling. REST accepts an array: ["\n\n", "###"], SDK expects a single string of comma-separated tokens which breaks quickstart prompts. First-timers hit odd truncation.

alex: ugh that explains the weird model outputs. My form was sending stop_sequences as [] when blank; REST treated empty array as omit, SDK validated type and errored.

ting: actionable plan: patch SDK to accept both shapes for stop_sequences (array or comma-separated), treat null/empty as omitted, and add a compatibility flag (allow_legacy_param_shapes) for minor releases. Add e2e for sampleapp posting blank/array/CSV.

ravi: I'll open DX-423 and add unit tests + a sampleapp CI job that runs the quickstart against the latest SDK + API. Also will change retry policy: don't retry on 401; only retry on idempotent endpoints or use idempotency-keys for mutating requests.

alex: please also add a note in the SDK migration guide. A lot of integrators bake in SDK defaults and won't notice endpoint additions.

devex-bot: jira:DX-423 created by ravi - "SDK/REST parity: models.metadata endpoint + stop_sequences shape + auth retry policy" :spiral_note_pad:

ting: assigning to eng-sdks, tagging eng-runtime for retry logic. Thanks team.

alex: re-ran onboarding locally with a patched sdk and things look much smoother now. Will follow up if any other parity quirks show up. :thumbsup:
